analysis.title: Hyperscalers & EM Credit: Mapping the Supply, Spread and Cross-Market Impacts
key_insights: Hyperscaler credit curves steepened materially versus matched investment-grade benchmarks through much of 2026 as AI-related financing increased long-end supply. That divergence has since retraced.
The open question is how the next phase of hyperscaler issuance will be absorbed across global credit markets.
Credit risk across the AI financing ecosystem remains highly differentiated: data-center spreads remain materially wider than hyperscaler credit.
30-year hyperscaler spreads remain above 10-year exposures, showing dispersion by issuer type and maturity.

The note is a Marquee webinar companion for a Nov 16, 2026 10:00 AM ET discussion on supply, spreads and sentiment in hyperscaler and EM credit. It lists Marquee tools (Market View, PlotTool Pro, Bond Screener, Credit Pre-Trade 2.0, Credit Basket Suite) and carries no trade recommendation or figures.
GS states the message was prepared by FICC and Equities business personnel and is not Global Investment Research.
risk_factors: Absorption of new long-end hyperscaler issuance across global credit markets.
Wide data-center spreads relative to hyperscaler credit and a 30-year versus 10-year spread gap indicate dispersion risk across the AI financing ecosystem.
